DJ, broadcaster, writer, and dreamer Zakia Sewell provides the soundtrack to your dreams - playing music to ease the mind, soothe the soul, and open portals to new dimensions…

This week Zakia takes us on a dreamy journey around the globe with her selections from music new, old and some reissues. The show includes songs from ESG, Vashti Bunyan, Meridian Brothers and Anna Domino.

Plus, we hear from Nashville guitarist and composer. William Tyler as he share his dreams of an old family home and it's importance in his life, along with dreams of travel to locations he has yet to visit. He also shares his Dreambience mix inspired partially by the soundtrack from the Shining and music free from the restraints of time and genre. 

We want to hear your dreams! Send in tales of your sleepy adventures to dreamtime@bbc.co.uk.

A Reduced Listening Production for BBC Radio 6 Music.

synopses.medium: Zakia provides the soundtrack for your dreams, with lots of sweet, soothing and playful selections. Plus, we travel down the Portal with Danish sound artist Sofie Birch.
synopses.long:
DJ, broadcaster, writer and dreamer Zakia Sewell provides the soundtrack to your dreams - playing music to ease the mind, soothe the soul, and open portals to new dimensions.

This week Zakia leans into sweet, soothing and playful selections, sharing some of the new releases she’s been enjoying this summer. There’s new music from ddwy, Blind Yeo, Jeremiah Chiu and Saul Williams, as well as some older favourites from Broadcast, Antena,  Barefoot Jerry and of course Dolly Parton. 

Plus, we travel down the Portal with Danish composer, synthesist, sound artist and tarot enthusiast Sofie Birch. We take a trip to the small island where Sofie lives to hear about her new album Bivabippabualukka, her dreams of boats and waves, and why she sometimes feels like a medieval prince. 

We want to hear your dreams! Send in tales of your sleepy adventures to dreamtime@bbc.co.uk.

A Reduced Listening Production for BBC Radio 6 Music.
